_readme: GENERATED by scripts/generate-revision-sheet.mjs — never hand-edit. A LENS over the two question universes: rows reference the universe that owns each problem. Row layout: [subIdx, kind, ...] where kind 0=curriculum [.., questionId], 1=library [.., slug], 2=sheet-only [.., sheetProblemIdx], 3=external [.., title, diffCode|null, platformIdx, verifiedUrl?] (the optional 6th column is a hand-verified https link from scripts/data/external-links.json; unlisted rows stay unlinked), 4=ambiguous [.., title, diffCode|null, note]. diffCode 0=easy 1=medium 2=hard 3=theory. sheetProblems rows: [slug, frontendId, title, diffCode, premium, tagIdxs, patternIdxs, inferredPatternIdxs, confidenceCode(0=unmapped,1=heuristic,2=strong,3=exact)]. Sheet-only problems carry NO contest rating — they are unrated, and absence is stored as absence. Decode via src/data/revisionSheet.ts.
